description: This Java class handles deposit commands for GSIM accounts within the Fineract project. It acts as a command handler that processes deposit requests and delegates the operation to a service responsible for savings account operations.

classes.name: GSIMDepositCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles deposit commands for GSIM accounts by implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface. It delegates deposit processing to the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the deposit command by calling the gsimDeposit method of the service with the savings ID and command data.
